articles.title: The U.S. government is betting $2 Billion on quantum computing, and the defense side can't keep up
articles.snippet: Pruden argues that to defend against a quantum computer capable of cryptographically relevant operations, we need post-quantum cryptography and regulatory coordination that the industry has been deferring for years.

articles.title: Exclusive: KuCoin has not paid $2M award tied to delisted token dispute, investor says
articles.snippet: A Seychelles court said KuCoin can’t treat unwithdrawn tokens as “abandoned,” and awarded a Swiss investor over $2 million. He said the exchange still hasn’t paid and plans to sue again.

articles.title: SpaceX IPO update: Whale opens $22.3M SPCX long as synthetic price hits 30% premium
articles.snippet: SpaceX’s IPO hype may fuel a strong debut, but history shows richly valued listings often struggle after the first-day pop fades.

articles.title: Iran-Linked Group That Hacked Kash Patel's Email Threatens World Cup With Hijacked FBI Drones
articles.snippet: The Iran-linked hacking group said it accessed footage from FBI-controlled drones and warned World Cup teams that they could be targeted.

articles.title: Gary Gensler Backs States in Fight Over Prediction Market Regulation
articles.snippet: The former SEC and CFTC chair says Congress "categorically" did not intend to put sports betting under exclusive federal oversight.
